components.label: Ignore policy surface
components.rationale: .gitignore defines exclusion policies across logs, build outputs, dependency dirs, and tool caches.

components.label: Versioned tree surface
components.rationale: Git-tracked files (e.g. LICENSE, .gitignore) are the durable state surface of the workspace.

components.label: Registry resolution surface
components.rationale: Ignore patterns for node_modules and npm logs imply package resolution against a registry API.

components.label: Local install tree surface
components.rationale: node_modules and related paths are the local materialization of dependencies (ignored, not committed).
